ops.text: One crate, two paths: the default `std` feature as today, and without it core + alloc, float maths through libm (units::float_math), compile-time target features in place of runtime CPU detection, lookup tables through a race-once cell (units::lazy) and no per-thread caches. flux, gpu, and linalg / systems (faer) stay behind std, as do streams over std::io. Without default features the build is also lean: only units, simd and geometry compile; the default feature `dsp` adds every other module, so the no_std DSP build is default-features = false with dsp. CI builds the no_std paths (lean and dsp) for wasm32 and runs the tests and clippy on each.
